description: Use this when a garment's photo shows its back but Uwear has it as the front (or the other way round): you saw the photo in this chat, or the user says so. side back makes the photo the garment's back, so back shots run from it; front undoes that. When the board holds the same garment twice, front and back photos as two garments, pass garment_id (the front) with side back and from_garment_id (the back): one garment with both photos. Call it yourself and continue (confirm_brief if the user asked to run): never ask the user to relabel a photo on the board. The board's brief is saved again with its new quote. Deletes nothing.

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

from_garment_id.description: side back only: a board garment whose photo is garment_id's back (the same garment added twice). Its photo becomes garment_id's back; it leaves the board, kept in the library

garment_id.description: the garment (clothing id on the board, or worn by a look of its brief)

side.description: what its photo shows: back makes it the garment's back photo

name: set_garment_side
title: Set Garment Side
